summary.method: static: nm -U symbol table (Rust v0 path idents), exact byte search in __TEXT __const/__cstring, ADRP+ADD pair decoding over __text (<=8 insn window). Not REA; REA Ghidra per-address xrefs re-import the 70 MB binary per call (~32 min).
limitations: Candidate list includes setting keys and event names, not only #[tauri::command] names; handler_fn is the conductor_lib path of the best symbol ending in the name (fn > closure > drop_glue of its future > generic); handler_fn_addr is set only for a plain fn symbol. null means no conductor_lib symbol ends in that name (inlined, renamed, or not a command).
v0 demangling is best-effort path-ident extraction, no generic args.
ADRP+ADD decoding misses LDR-literal, ADR and register-computed string loads; absence of a reference is bounded to that pattern.
Decoded from shipped bytes; not original source.
